title.narrative: Punjab Irrigated Agriculture Investment Program - Project 2

description.narrative: The new Khanki Barrage (NKB) will be constructed on River Chenab at 275m downstream of the existing khanki headworks. It will replace a 120 years old existing structure. Its main components are (i) main weir and undersluices, (ii) gates and hoisting arrangement, (iii) operating deck and access road, and (iv) canal head regulator and lead channel. The NKB will diver 330 m3sec-1 (11,653 ft3 sec-1) irrigation supplies to the Lower Chenab Canal (LCC) serving about 1.2 million ha agricultural land. The construction of NKB at the upstream end will ensure sustained irrigation delivery to the LCC comman area and will contribute to the outcome of the MFF. The NKB at the upstream end will ensure sustained irrigation delivery to the LCC command are and will contribute to the outcome of the MFF. The NKB will also increase the safe flood discharge capacity from the present 22,654 m3sec-1 (800,000 ft3sec-1) which is less than a one fifty years flood event to 31,149 m3sec-1 (1,100,000 ft3sec-1) equivalent to one in 100 years flood event. Overall 568,000 farming families (310,000 less than 2 ha and 190,000 between 2 to 6 ha) will be benefitted through reliable irrigation supplies.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. New Khanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget. Indicator: • 3 contracts awarded according to schedule Progress/Status: One NCB civil works contract was merged with ICB contract due to failure of bid for NCB. The ICB works contract was awarded on 30 May 2013. The consultancy contract was awarded on 27 Feb 2013. Data Source: • EA's quarterly report. Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017

Output: 1. New Khanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget. Indicator: • All contracts are within contingencies limits Progress/Status: All contracts were within contingency limits. Data Source: • EA's quarterly report. Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017

Output: 1. New Khanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget. Indicator: • Annual diversion to LCC increased from max of 7991 million cubic meters in 2011 to max of 8286 million cubic meters in 2017. Progress/Status: The new Khanki Barrage has provided annual diversion to LCC increased from maximum of 7991 million cubic meters (6,472 million acre feet) in 2011 to maximum of 8,286 million cubic meters/6.711 million acre feet by 2017 with no risk to sustainable deliveries and to make use of excessive supplies. Data Source: • Director, Regulation of PID for barrage operation data. Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017

Output: 1. New Khanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget. Indicator: • New barrage eliminated the annual water leakage of 370 million cubic meter by 2017. Progress/Status: Water leakages of 370 million cubic meters has been eliminated after completion of barrage construction. Data Source: • Director, Regulation of PID for barrage operation data Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017

Output: 1. New Khanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget. Indicator: • The flood capacity increased from 22,654 m3s-1 in 2011 to 31,150 m3s-1 in 2017. Progress/Status: Flood capacity has been increased from 800,000 cfs to 110,000 cfs on completion. Data Source: • EA's quarterly report. Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017

Output: 2. EA's improved project management efficiency. Indicator: • PMO's 11 senior staff trained through learning by doing Progress/Status: 20 Engineers of PID was sent to AIT for Master in Water Resources and Irrigation Engineering. Data Source: • EA's quarterly report. Baseline year: 2011 Baseline year: 2011 Target year: 2017
The sustainable improved delivery of services for irrigated agriculture and better water management in LCC command areas.
